entities.summary: Böhlau Verlag is a book and magazine publisher predominantly of humanities and social science disciplines, based in Vienna and Cologne, with a branch in Weimar. They describe their focus as being "from the historically oriented humanities". The publishing house was an independent and privately owned media corporation until it was acquired by Vandenhoeck & Ruprecht in 2017.
